title: How to tell the job interview went well - Signs of a potential job offer
description:
How to tell the job interview went well - Signs of a potential job offer

Have you finished your interview but couldn't tell how it went? Was your interviewer hard to read? In this video we'll explain 5 signs that your interview went well and you might be getting a potential job offer.

- If your interview went over time
- The recruiter contacts you right after the interview
- If they ask if you're interviewing at other companies
- They give long answers to your questions 
- You have impromptu meetings
